name: XERJ
description: Indexes code, docs, logs, and PDFs locally so coding agents can run cited full-text, vector, and hybrid search over MCP, a CLI, or an Elasticsearch-compatible API.

skills.name: Zero-Config Autoindex
skills.description: Turns a folder of code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV, PDFs, and office files into typed, queryable indices.

skills.name: Full-Text, Vector, and Hybrid Search
skills.description: Runs BM25, kNN, semantic, and fused hybrid queries; the default embedder is lexical unless neural mode is turned on.

skills.name: Go-to-Definition
skills.description: Finds local symbol definitions with file, line, and signature through xerj def or the xerj_def tool.

skills.name: Agent Memory
skills.description: Stores durable agent memory in namespaces and recalls it by text, meaning, or vector.

skills.name: Reference Coding
skills.description: Indexes the open-source repos closest to a task so an agent can search how they solved it before writing code.
